message.reasoning: We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "I keep getting bounced back to the sign-in page after approving SSO at our identity provider — is my redirect URL wrong?" This matches DOC-008 about redirect loop due to URL mismatch. We can give steps: check callback URL, compare with reply URL, ensure exact match, re-save. Provide short answer. No need to escalate. Use post_reply.

function.arguments: {"message":"That behavior is usually caused by a redirect‑URL mismatch. Open Settings → Security → SSO → Configuration in Meridian and copy the exact callback URL shown there. Then go to your identity provider and make sure the reply URL (or redirect URI) matches that callback URL character‑for‑character – even a missing trailing slash or an http/https difference will cause the loop. After correcting any discrepancy, re‑save the application on the identity‑provider side (some providers cache the old value until you do). Once the URLs match, the sign‑in should complete without bouncing back."}
